name: Default
shortDescription: Real-time server for WebSocket and SSE clients using the Action Cable protocol, running standalone with JWT authentication, signed streams and an HTTP broadcast API.

alerts.message: There is no web UI. Your backend signs client JWTs and stream names with ANYCABLE_SECRET and publishes by POSTing to https://<your domain>/_broadcast with the header Authorization: Bearer <ANYCABLE_BROADCAST_KEY>. Clients connect to wss://<your domain>/cable or https://<your domain>/events (SSE).
